name: Cheese English Muffins
description: Toasted English muffin quarters topped with a rich cheese and bacon mixture.
recipeIngredient: ½ lb sharp yellow cheese, grated

recipeInstructions.text: Mix grated cheese, mayonnaise, Worcestershire sauce, crumbled bacon, and chopped onion together.
Slice English muffins into quarters.
Spread the cheese mixture onto the English muffin quarters.
Bake at 400°F for 10 minutes.

_similar.name: Cheese Dip in a Bread Bowl
_similar.description: A warm cheese and ham dip served in a hollowed-out bread loaf.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the top off the bread loaf and hollow out most of the soft bread inside.
Mix together the cream cheese, sour cream, ham, green pepper, green onion, cheddar cheese, Tabasco sauce, and Worcestershire sauce.
Fill the hollowed bread loaf with the cheese mixture and replace the lid.
Wrap the loaf in tinfoil and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.
Serve hot with the reserved bread chunks and fresh veggies for dipping.

_similar.keywords: bread bowl dip, ham and cheese dip, party appetizer

_similar.name: Bacon Broccoli Salad
_similar.description: A hearty broccoli salad with crispy bacon, red onion, and a tangy dressing featuring low-fat yogurt and feta cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine the broccoli, red onion, sunflower seeds, raisins, and crumbled bacon in a large salad bowl.
In a separate bowl, mix together the yogurt, mayonnaise, sugar, and lemon juice to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad ingredients and toss to coat.
Refrigerate for 2 hours to allow the flavors to meld.

_similar.keywords: broccoli salad, bacon salad, yogurt dressing

_similar.name: Jelly Roll Style Meat Loaf
_similar.description: A creative meat loaf recipe shaped like a jelly roll, filled with mozzarella cheese and baked in a loaf pan.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup cracker crumbs or dry bread crumbs

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients except ground beef in a large bowl, using only 1 cup of mozzarella cheese.
Add ground beef and mix thoroughly with hands until just combined.
Shape the mixture into a 10x12 inch rectangle on waxed paper.
Sprinkle 2 cups of mozzarella cheese over the meat.
Roll up the mixture like a jelly roll using the waxed paper and press ends together to seal.
Place the foil-wrapped jelly roll in a meat loaf pan and bake in a 350°F oven for 1 hour.
Drain off fat and pour reserved tomato sauce on the roll.
Bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes before slicing.
Decorate with tomato slices and green parsley on a serving tray.

_similar.keywords: meat loaf, jelly roll, mozzarella cheese, baked

_similar.name: Hot Cheese Dip
_similar.description: A creamy bacon and cheddar dip baked inside a pumpernickel bread shell.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the top off the pumpernickel loaf and hollow it out, leaving a thick shell.
Mix the cream cheese, mayonnaise, cheddar cheese, and bacon bits until well combined.
Spoon the mixture into the hollowed-out bread.
Wrap the loaf in tinfoil, leaving the hole with the cheese mixture uncovered.
Bake at 325°F for 1½ hours.
Serve hot with the bread pieces.

_similar.keywords: pumpernickel dip, hot bacon dip, cheddar dip

_similar.name: Cheese Ball
_similar.description: A classic cheese ball made with grated cheese, Cheez Whiz, and deviled ham, perfect for a quick appetizer.
recipeIngredient: Chopped pecans or parsley flakes for coating

recipeInstructions.text: Beat all ingredients in a mixer until creamed.
Form into 2 balls and wrap in Saran Wrap.
Refrigerate until firm.
Roll into chopped pecans or parsley flakes to coat.

_similar.keywords: cheese ball, party appetizer, easy snack
